# Why did my Squarespace product import fail?

> Free Squarespace product CSV checker: finds variant rows that start new products, duplicate SKUs and Product URLs, bad prices, On Sale without a Sale Price, wrong Yes/No flags, broken Hosted Image URLs, Excel-damaged SKUs and semicolon files, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
